mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll ( store_id, store_staff_id, target_year_month, range_start_date, range_end_date, work_days_count, total_work_minutes, total_night_minutes, total_overtime_minutes, applied_hourly_wage, applied_transport_limit, base_pay, night_allowance, overtime_allowance, transport_allowance, gross_pay, payroll_status ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{storeStaffId}, #{targetYearMonth}, #{rangeStartDate}, #{rangeEndDate}, #{workDaysCount}, #{totalWorkMinutes}, #{totalNightMinutes}, #{totalOvertimeMinutes}, #{appliedHourlyWage}, #{appliedTransportLimit}, #{basePay}, #{nightAllowance}, #{overtimeAllowance}, #{transportAllowance}, #{grossPay}, #{payrollStatus} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE work_days_count = VALUES(work_days_count), total_work_minutes = VALUES(total_work_minutes), total_night_minutes = VALUES(total_night_minutes), total_overtime_minutes = VALUES(total_overtime_minutes), applied_hourly_wage = VALUES(applied_hourly_wage), applied_transport_limit = VALUES(applied_transport_limit), base_pay = VALUES(base_pay), night_allowance = VALUES(night_allowance), overtime_allowance = VALUES(overtime_allowance), transport_allowance = VALUES(transport_allowance), gross_pay = VALUES(gross_pay), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

mapper.update: UPDATE payroll SET payroll_status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payroll_id = #{payrollId} AND payroll_status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE payroll p SET p.payroll_status = 'CONFIRMED', p.confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, p.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE p.store_id = #{storeId} AND p.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} AND p.payroll_status = 'DRAFT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance a WHERE a.store_staff_id = p.store_staff_id AND a.work_date >= p.range_start_date AND a.work_date <= p.range_end_date AND a.attendance_status IN ('WORKING', 'ON_BREAK', 'MOD_REQUESTED') )
